Methodology

  • Source: Bybit public API v5, GET /v5/market/funding/history (category linear), full history downloaded by paging backwards 200 records at a time.
  • Funding rate: the rate paid at each settlement, as a % of position notional. Positive: longs pay shorts. Negative: shorts pay longs.
  • Funding interval: not assumed; measured as the time between consecutive settlements: interval = ti − ti-1 (hours).
  • Annualized rate (simple, no compounding): annualized = rate × 8760 / interval_hours. Example: 0.01% every 8h → 0.01% × 1095 = 10.95% per year.
  • Moving averages: mean of the annualized rate over the last 7 and 30 calendar days, (t − N days, t]. The first N days of history are left blank.
  • Cumulative funding: running sum of the funding rates, cumulativet = rate1 + … + ratet: the share of notional a long would have paid (a short received) holding a constant position, without compounding.
Analysis tool only, not investment advice. Data from Bybit's public API, provided as is.
